records.title: RCS- UDAN scheme for Tamil Nadu
details: a to e: For the development of Tanjore Airport, AAI has requested the Government of Tamil Nadu to provide a straight and direct approach road to the Airport, as the existing land area does not have straight connectivity to the National Highway. The land is yet to be provided by the State Government.

records.title: Subsidy to MSME Units in Tamil Nadu
details: c: Presently, under PMEGP, 10,587 sanctioned applications by Banks are under process for validation and approval by the nodal implementing agency.

records.title: Women Beneficiaries under PM-Svanidhi Scheme
details: h: The proposal of expansion/restructuring of PMSVANidhi scheme, which includes enhanced loans, credit cards with ₹30,000 limit and capacity building of street vendors, is under consideration of the Government.

records.title: CAPACITY OF FCI
details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

The construction and maintenance of FCI storage facilities in remote and difficult
areas all over India including North East region is done through Central Sector Scheme
“Storage and Godowns” (CSS). Apart from it a separate modified PEG Scheme with
higher guarantee period etc. is under consideration of DFPD , Government of India.

records.title: UDAN SCHEME FOR TAMIL NADU
details:
Licensing of Vellore and Nevyeli is under progress. State Government is yet to provide suitable land for development of civil enclave at Ramnad. At Tanjore, construction of civil enclave can be taken up by AAI on
provision of required Approach Road by the State Government.
